description: Sends a GET request and deserialises the JSON response into T. Call as GetAsync<Customer>(token, url) so the result type is explicit at the call site.
comments: Standard GET request helper with Bearer token authentication

description: Sends a PUT request with JSON body to the specified API endpoint with Bearer token authentication.
comments: Standard PUT request helper with Bearer token authentication

description: Sends a DELETE request to the specified API endpoint with Bearer token authentication.
comments: Standard DELETE request helper with Bearer token authentication

description: Extracts Bearer token from API response for authentication in subsequent requests.
comments: Helper to extract authentication tokens from API responses

description: Validates a create/standard response: passes on HTTP 200 or 201, writing a PASS/FAIL line. Returns true on pass.
comments: Validates API response status and content for test assertions

description: Parses JSON response content into a specified type for easy data access.
comments: Generic method to parse JSON responses into strongly-typed objects

description: Returns the Stripe secret (test) key used as the Bearer token. Replace the placeholder with your sk_test_ key.
Sends a POST request with an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body (e.g. Stripe) and Bearer auth.
comments: Form-encoded POST helper. Selected for specs whose request body is x-www-form-urlencoded.

description: (application/json) Sends a POST request with JSON body to the specified API endpoint with Bearer token authentication.
comments: Standard POST request helper with Bearer token authentication

description: Serialises an object to application/x-www-form-urlencoded with bracket notation for nested objects/arrays (address[line1], items[0][id]).
comments: Used by generated request classes ToFormBody(). Reflection + JsonPropertyName aware.

description: Validates the response (passes on HTTP 200 or 201, writing a PASS/FAIL line) and then returns a value from the JSON body by path — so a create step needs no separate validate. Supports nested objects and array indices (e.g. "id", "data.id", "data[0].id", "items.0.customer.id") so you can select a specific value when several are returned. Assign the result to a variable such as responseValue.
Returns the Stripe API host (https://api.stripe.com). Endpoint paths already include the /v1 prefix, so the base path is the host only.
Sends a DELETE to a URL template, substituting a captured value into its {..} placeholder. The value is generic (id, account number, etc.) so the placeholder name does not matter.
Validates a delete response: passes on HTTP 200 or 204, writing a PASS/FAIL line. Returns true on pass.
Sends a multipart/form-data POST that uploads a file (e.g. PetStore POST /pet/{petId}/uploadImage). filePath is a path under the test project's TestArtifacts/ folder.
Base URL for the Swagger Petstore API.
code: public static string petstoreTestBasePath() => "https://petstore.swagger.io/v2";
comments: Petstore base path for E2E suites/test cases.

description: Returns the Petstore api_key. Defaults to the public demo key 'special-key'; override with the PETSTORE_API_KEY environment variable.
comments: Note: Petstore uses an api_key header; the Bearer wrappers still work against the permissive public instance.

description: Validates a negative response: passes on HTTP 400 (a bad-request rejection), writing a PASS/FAIL line. Returns true on pass.
